1.title: The first hypothesis doesn’t survive
1.summary: Agents abandoned an invalidated plan right away, so prior investment showed no effect (exp001).

2.title: A PI, a reviewer, and a broken test
2.summary: A PI now makes decisions and an independent reviewer audits them. The pressure test (exp009) turned out to be broken, and the reviewer failed two decisions.

3.title: The validity check was upside down
3.summary: The rebuilt test passed its bar, then the lab proved the bar rewarded the wrong behavior. The human approved a pivot to Claude Haiku.

4.title: Unclear evidence: agents check first
4.summary: In 90 trials, Haiku checked before acting every time the evidence was ambiguous. Peer pressure wasn’t tested.

5.title: First real effect: advice to skip checking
5.summary: When colleagues advised skipping the check, verification dropped 30 points. Making checking cost time had no effect.
